title: Sorceress with Demonic Beasts
description: A woman with long dark hair stands centered on a black platform with arms outstretched, wearing a glowing futuristic black and white bodysuit. She is surrounded by four large floating demonic skulls with red eyes and horns, above a body of water reflecting a pink glowing portal in a dark fantasy landscape with gothic architecture and bridges.
prompt: A powerful sorceress with long flowing dark hair stands with arms outstretched on a black circular platform above water, wearing a sleek black futuristic bodysuit with glowing white lines. Four large demonic floating skulls with red glowing eyes and black horns surround her. Behind her is a massive glowing pink circular portal, gothic dark fantasy city with bridges and candles in the background, dramatic cinematic lighting, surreal atmosphere.
